subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: renewal + retention change request
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novuscorp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novuscorp.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: renewal + retention change request

Hi Jonas,

As we approach our renewal (term renewal date 2027-07-31), the security team has a couple of asks related to the upcoming SOC 2 re-attestation:

1) Retention window: Novus needs an increase from your standard 12-month audit-log retention to 24 months for our private deployment (data stored in us-east-1). Please confirm feasibility, expected timelines for enabling this for our account, and whether exports will be whole-log or per-bucket snapshots.

2) Evidence package: we need a consolidated evidence bundle (logs, configuration snapshots, and attestation artifacts) for the SOC 2 refresh. Can Redwood provide a pre-packaged evidence export and a short mapping to the AIC controls?

3) Contract amendment: procurement asked for an addendum that covers the retention uplift and a short-term seat uplift for the renewal period. Please include any pricing delta or seat-rate changes.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call next week to walk through options? I attached our preliminary security questionnaire for reference.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Senior Manager, Information Security
NovusCorp

Attachments:
- security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 18 pages)

From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novuscorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: renewal + retention change request

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear note and the questionnaire. We're happy to support Novus on the SOC 2 re-attestation and the retention uplift. High-level next steps:

- Log retention: We can enable a 24-month retention profile for your private deployment. I'll loop in Kimberly (our security/compliance lead) to confirm the delivery model (snapshot vs. continuous export) and the storage/pricing delta.
- Evidence bundle: we prepare a mapped evidence package for SOC 2 re-attestations; we'll produce an AIC control map and a consolidated export.
- Contract amendment: we'll draft an addendum that combines the retention uplift, a temporary seat increase (pricing note included), and an explicit evidence delivery SLA.

Can we do Wed 6/16 at 11:00am PT for a 30-minute call? If that works I'll send a calendar invite. In the meantime, I've shared an evidence matrix drive link and a placeholder DocuSign amendment for procurement to review.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/novus-evidence-matrix
DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/NVS-0043

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Novus retention uplift — ops + pricing notes

Jonas / Karthik,

Quick internal note before we talk to Novus tomorrow:

- Feasibility: 24-month retention is supported for private deployments. We have two delivery models:
  a) Rolling retention increase (keep existing cluster, change retention policy) — lower operational overhead but slower bulk backfill.
  b) Snapshot export to long-term object store (S3) with an indexed manifest — quicker to hand off to customer but involves export job runs.

- Cost impact: rough estimate attached (retention_cost_model.csv). For a 24-month window we should propose: 1) a 6-month promotional credit for retention-storage costs on renewal sign, then 2) a recurring per-GB surcharge in the amended quote.

- Evidence bundle: we can produce a SOC 2 evidence package mapped to AIC with a short runbook for Novus security. I recommend including: configuration snapshot, access/role change logs for the prior 12 months, KV cache usage summary, and a signed attestation excerpt. Template attached: evidence_inventory_template.xlsx.

- Sales motion: propose the amendment (amendment_draft.docx) that adds the retention clause, a 3-month complimentary seat top-up (pro-rated), and a 12-month commitment to the new retention profile. That should make procurement more comfortable while giving us time to operationalize backfill.

I'll be on the call tomorrow; have the cost model ready.

—Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: retention_cost_model.csv, evidence_inventory_template.xlsx, amendment_draft.docx

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novuscorp.com>

Thanks — Wed at 11 PT worked well, appreciate the walkthrough. A few follow-ups from our side:

1) Export frequency: we prefer nightly snapshot exports to an S3 bucket we manage (bucket location us-east-1). Can Redwood script that export and provide a manifest with checksums?
2) Evidence mapping: we requested the AIC map and the evidence bundle format; procurement will need the draft amendment before end of next week for legal review.
3) Attestation timing: SOC 2 re-attestation is scheduled for mid-September — we need the bundled evidence by 2027-08-20.

I've uploaded a signed copy of our supplier questionnaire to the drive and attached a short doc from legal that lists required amendment clauses (see attachments). Please include the export window, manifest format, and delivery SLA in the amendment.

Regards,
Emily Zhang

NovusCorp

Emily — thanks for the call and the docs. Confirming commitments and next steps:

- Retention plan: we'll schedule nightly snapshot exports to your us-east-1 S3 bucket. Exports will include a manifest (JSON lines) with object paths and SHA256 checksums. The first backfill run (historical 24-month window) will be executed in two phases to avoid performance impact; we expect completion by 2027-07-29.

- Evidence bundle: security/compliance will deliver the mapped AIC evidence package by 2027-08-10 (meets your 8/20 deadline with buffer).

- Amendment & pricing: attached is the draft amendment (amendment_draft.docx) that captures: retention window change, export SLA, a 3-month complimentary seat top-up on renewal, and the per-GB retention surcharge thereafter. Procurement: please review and we can route via DocuSign.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/NVS-0043
Drive (evidence map + uploads): https://drive.google.com/novus-evidence-matrix
